text: THIEF: Your key. Your money. In crypto, every transfer is final.
UNDO: Final? Not for five minutes.
UNDO: Time has stopped. Only you and I can see this.
UNDO: Every transfer waits five minutes. Until then, nothing is final. Not even for him.
UNDO: No judge. No vote. Just: back.
THIEF: Hey. Where did it go?
THIEF: Fine. I'm a store now. Pay up.
UNDO: Got scammed? Hit report. A private AI reads both sides, sealed. Three people decide. The AI can't move a cent.
UNDO: That was a story. This part is real.
UNDO: A real panic, on the NEAR test network. We paid the gas, not your phone.
UNDO: We set a trap wallet and tried to rob it. Frozen in 21 seconds.
UNDO: A fake seller slipped a secret order to the AI judge. It noticed.
UNDO: The contract has no keys. Not even we can change it.
UNDO: Undo. Ctrl+Z, for your money.
